pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sub-polygonal dark regions with blurred edge gradients. The geometry of individual patches is irregular, with spatial area notably decreasing as the pattern approaches the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A topological lattice of light-colored pathways separating the darker patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. The pathways are continuous with a thin, consistent pixel width across the mid-section and flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, dark fringe along the upper neck and shoulder area, creating a finely serrated 1D silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, vertically oriented white pixel cluster is located on the mid-dorsal ridge, representing a significant local deviation in color and texture compared to the adjacent pelage.
